title: The Hall of Honor

logos.name: Company logo (griffin + wordmark)
logos.treatment: Background removed; alpha mask recolored maroon (light) / cream (dark)

badges.name: Proud Veteran (original, used for veterans with no branch listed)
Proud Veteran base (branch list removed from ring)
badges.use: Branch badges: Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, National Guard, Royal Air Force; branch name drawn on the bottom ring as SVG text in gold serif

badges.name: Years of Service (general)
badges.use: Main Service Anniversaries tile and panel header; built from the 25-year badge with the numerals removed and the griffin re-centered at 1.3x

branding.badgeNote: Official branch seals not reproduced; branch badges are built from the customer's Proud Veteran artwork

content.layout: Grid of 4 program badges; tapping a badge opens nested drop-downs; one open per level; newest first

bravo.note: Quarter taken from QUARTER column, else derived from MONTH; 1999 rows with no month shown as 'Year-round'

goldenGondola.source: ACTIVE_TM_GOLDEN_GONDOLA-_2025.xlsx and -_2026.xlsx (period sheets only; ACTIVE = Match)
goldenGondola.row: Name, tier (Experience / Maestro / Unexpected Joy), department
goldenGondola.note: Quarter from Posting Date; when the date is missing (#REF!) or outside its sheet's period, the period start date is used. Nomination comments excluded.

serviceAnniversaries.drilldown: Milestone badge (5/10/15/20/25) > Month (all 12, incl. upcoming) > Names
serviceAnniversaries.note: Names taken from the ACTIVE TM roster (Bravo workbook) by TM#
serviceAnniversaries.mainBadge: General Years of Service badge (no number); milestone badges 5/10/15/20/25 appear on open

veterans.mapping: Multi-branch entries listed under each branch (shown with '+ Other branch'); Army Reserve > Army; Army National Guard and Air National Guard > National Guard
veterans.consent: Customer confirmed all names may be displayed

content.search: All four programs, as-you-type, accent-insensitive; each result shows its badge and award; tap a result to open it in its drop-down

standard.trigger: No ID, unknown ID, or unresolved token

accolade.trigger: Viewer has a Bravo!, Golden Gondola or 2026 service milestone
accolade.display: Most recent accolade up to today (an upcoming 2026 anniversary is shown only if there is nothing earlier)

copy.bravo: Congratulations on your Bravo! award / {Qn YYYY}
copy.goldenGondola: Congratulations on your Golden Gondola / {tier}, {Qn YYYY}
copy.serviceUpcoming: Your {n}-year anniversary is coming up / {Mon D, YYYY}

veteran.trigger: Viewer is on the veterans list
veteran.display: 'Thank you for your service' card with branch; if the viewer also has an accolade, the thank-you appears as an extra line on that card

content.viewButton: Opens the drop-down path to the viewer's entry and highlights it; viewer's rows starred everywhere
content.privacy: Only names, departments and award details embedded. Employee numbers stored as FNV-1a hashes; emails, phones, supervisors, comments and pronunciation notes excluded.

data.matching: employeeid first, employeeCode fallback; leading zeros, short letter prefixes and spaces ignored
data.dataSource: Static, embedded from the five project spreadsheets

display.sizing: Fills the iframe/viewport and reflows live on resize
display.renderingContext: Phone tile (primary); scales to tablet, desktop and lobby screens

layoutTiers.wide (>=760 wide, >=420 tall, landscape-: Left: header, personal card, search, 2x2 badge grid. Right: drop-downs or search results
layoutTiers.<=300 tall: Compact badge tiles; personal card shows headline only

sizeJustification: Over the 150 KB target (under the 250 KB ceiling): ~87 KB is ten badge images (WebP) and ~92 KB is 2,543 award records across four programs
browserNote: Badges use WebP (supported in iOS 14+ and all current Android WebViews)
